ai_summary: Aaple Sarkar (MahaOnline) is Maharashtra's single-window portal for certificates and schemes.
ai_explanation: Maharashtra's Aaple Sarkar / MahaOnline portal lets residents apply for caste, income, residence, and other certificates plus state schemes from one place, with online tracking and SETU centre support. It is the gateway to most Maharashtra e-services.
